# KONE Chad

> > KONE Chad distributor providing elevators, escalators, and automatic doors to improve urban flow and building mobility in Chad.

KONE's Chad operation focuses on vertical transportation equipment and services including elevators (ascenseurs), escalators, and automatic doors (portes-automatiques) for urban buildings. The distributor offers modernization services and movement management solutions to enhance people flow in Chad's built environment.

## Key Topics

- KONE
- ascenseurs (elevators)
- escalators
- portes-automatiques (automatic doors)
- modernisation (modernization)
- gestion-deplacements (movement management)
- batiments-urbains (urban buildings)
- equipements-verticaux (vertical equipment)
- fluidité urbaine (urban flow)
- solutions de mobilité (mobility solutions)
